text.p: Entergy Security said Monday it has agreed to its 12th acquisition in less than a year, signing a definitive agreement to acquire the Ranger American group of companies for undisclosed terms.
The expansion increases the Entergy Corp subsidiary's customer total to 140,000 and annual revenues to more than $53 million. The closing of the transaction is expected to occur early next month.
Entergy Security said the acquisition is rated by industry observers as the largest acquisition of a privately held firm in the electronic security industry.

As part of the transaction, Entergy said, it will license the name Ranger American back to Ranger American owners Ed Woodlee and Ron Bowden, of San Antonio, Texas, and Wayne Hayes of Houston who will continue to sell and install Entergy Security systems in the new home market.
Ranger American's guard patrol business in San Antonio is not included in the acquisition. It will continue to be operated by Woodlee and Bowden.
